spec:
massive multiplayer tower climb — no checkpoints — chat's ideas become new tower sections every round

Pitch the viewers voted for: Side view. Everyone races up one tower stacked from random sections; fall and you fall. First to the top or highest after 3 min wins, then a new tower is built. One bump can drop the leader. Chat features add section types: spinners, conveyors, crumbling ledges.

Design brief:
Controls: move left/right; action = jump (hold for a slightly higher jump). No double jump on day one.
Round: a new tower is stacked from 12 random sections; everyone spawns on the ground floor. The round ends when the first player touches the top platform or after 180 s, then 5 s of results and a new tower.
Score: highest point reached this round; the first to the top wins and gets a crown burst. Leaderboard shows wins this session.
Players: no checkpoints, falling just drops you lower. Late joiners spawn at the bottom of the current tower. Players collide and can bump each other off ledges.
Tension: one bad jump or one bump can drop the leader several sections; the tower is the same for everyone, so a new player can beat a regular.
Spectate: follow the highest climber, cut to a long fall (big drop in height) when it happens.
Chat adds: new section types in a list the tower builder picks from (spinning bar, conveyor, crumbling ledge, trampoline, wind zone, ice). Each section has a height, a difficulty and its own step logic.
Day one: tower builder with 4 section types (static ledges, moving platform, gap jumps, narrow beams), side-view camera, jump physics, round loop, height bar.
